card.name: Slash and numbers in radiation dose tables
card.fires_on: The slash between dose and activity units (e.g. µSv/MBq) in radiation dosimetry tables, and digits or linking words inside dose or infusion-step ranges.

modes.label: Slash in dose per activity
modes.description: The / between a dose unit and MBq in absorbed-dose table headers.
modes.example: EFFECTIVE DOSE PER UNIT ADMINISTERED ACTIVITY (µSv<</>>MBq) 21.3

modes.label: Inside numeric ranges
modes.description: A digit or the word 'to' or 'next' within a range or stepwise amount, where a number follows.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it suppresses words like few and less, so it may mark that a number comes next.
card.plain: It fires on the slash in radiation dose per MBq tables and on parts of number ranges in dosing text.
